title: Derived internal Hom adjunction for derived pullback and direct image
statement: Let g:T\to S be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with derived pullback Lg^* [def-pc-derived-pullback], derived direct image Rg_* [def-pc-derived-direct-image] on the derived categories of [def-pc-derived-category], counit \varepsilon:Lg^*Rg_*\to\mathrm{id} of the adjunction of [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-adjoint-general], and derived internal Hom R\mathcal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. For K,L\in D(\mathcal O_S) let \gamma_{K,L}:R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_S}(K,L)\to Rg_*R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_T}(Lg^*K,Lg^*L) be the adjoint of the canonical map Lg^*R\mathcal Hom(K,L)\to R\mathcal Hom(Lg^*K,Lg^*L) (the map whose composite with evaluation Lg^*R\mathcal Hom(K,L)\otimes^{\mathbf L}Lg^*K\cong Lg^*(R\mathcal Hom(K,L)\otimes^{\mathbf L}K)\to Lg^*L is Lg^* of evaluation). Then for M\in D(\mathcal O_S) and E\in D(\mathcal O_T) the composite $$R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_S}(M,Rg_*E)\xrightarrow{\gamma_{M,Rg_*E}}Rg_*R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_T}(Lg^*M,Lg^*Rg_*E)\xrightarrow{Rg_*R\mathcal Hom(Lg^*M,\varepsilon_E)}Rg_*R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_T}(Lg^*M,E)$$ is an isomorphism in D(\mathcal O_S), natural in M and E. Moreover, under the identifications H^0(S,R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_S}(M,Rg_*E))=\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O_S)}(M,Rg_*E) and H^0(S,Rg_*R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_T}(Lg^*M,E))=H^0(T,R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_T}(Lg^*M,E))=\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O_T)}(Lg^*M,E) of [lem-pur-rhom-global-sections, lem-pc-derived-sections-pushforward-comparison], the map it induces on H^0(S,-) is \varphi\mapsto\varepsilon_E\circ Lg^*\varphi.
